title: Ozi Queue Auto-Discovery — Initialize work queue on first run
one_liner: If work queue doesn't exist in WAI-State.json, Ozi auto-discovers and builds it from current lugs (teachings → inbound → signals → local), ready for orchestration.
summary: When epic-ozi-work-queue-orchestration-v1 is first implemented, `_work_queue` won't exist in legacy WAI-State.json. Ozi should detect missing queue, scan current lug state, auto-populate queue with discovered items in priority order (teachings → inbound → signals → open lugs), mark readiness (ready vs needs_refinement), and present it to user for review/approval before starting orchestration.
motivation: Bootstrap path for existing projects. Queue auto-discovery means users don't have to manually populate the queue — Ozi looks at what exists and builds a sensible queue from current work.
acceptance_criteria: Wakeup Step 4.5 (new): Check if `_work_queue` exists in WAI-State.json
(1) Hub teachings in `seed/ingest/` → add to queue as priority 1
(2) Inbound lugs (hub deliveries) → add as priority 2
(4) Local lugs (epic/task/feature/bug open) → add as priority 4
For each lug: determine readiness state (ready vs needs_refinement)
- ready: has acceptance_criteria, estimated_steps, no blockers
- needs_refinement: missing acceptance criteria or blocker list unclear
Create `_work_queue` in WAI-State.json with discovered + sorted items
Present discovered queue to user: 'Built queue from X items. Review: Work it / Refine / Adjust'
User can adjust order, move items to needs_refinement, mark as blocked
scope: Wakeup Step 4.5: Auto-discovery detection + trigger logic
Queue builder logic: scan all lug types, prioritize, assess readiness
Readiness heuristics: check for acceptance_criteria field, estimated_steps, blocker_list
Briefing output: show discovered queue + prompt for review/adjustment
out_of_scope: Manual queue building (that's user job after discovery)
Automatic readiness prediction (always ask or mark for review)
implementation_notes: Auto-discovery is one-time bootstrap. After first run, queue exists and is maintained by lug creation + user edits.
scope_verified_by: user request (Session 73: 'Ozi logic is implemented it should scan what it has to build that queue if not there')
routing_notes: Bootstrap feature for queue orchestration. Feeds into epic-ozi-work-queue-orchestration-v1.
